# What a print-on-demand sale actually leaves you.

> Free print-on-demand profit calculator: profit per sale after Etsy, Shopify or eBay fees, supplier cost, shipping, refunds and ads; the price for your target margin; break-even ad spend and ROAS. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
